title: Hooknostic Subagent Definition 0.1 frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a subagent definition file (provisional; see docs/spec/subagents/0.1.md). The instructions are the Markdown body after the frontmatter and are not part of this schema.

name.description: The subagent's name; equals the file stem.

description.description: Single-line routing text: when the primary agent should delegate to this subagent.

native.description: Harness-only fields, keyed by the consumer's harness identifier. The consumer rejects identifiers it does not know and keys the portable core owns.
